Name: DGR 011 - Imhullu
Information:
**DGR 011 - IMHULLU**

A bird-like DGR unit that was designed to control battles in the air. Its primary function is to prevent the strategic movement of hostile forces by battering them with powerful winds, which it could generate even in the depths of space. It is capable of generating massive amounts of electrical energy and freely discharging it.

Information Sections.Title: DGR 011 - IMHULLU
Information Sections.Text: A bird-like DGR unit that was designed to control battles in the air. Its primary function is to prevent the strategic movement of hostile forces by battering them with powerful winds, which it could generate even in the depths of space. It is capable of generating massive amounts of electrical energy and freely discharging it.

traits.name: Galeforce Generator
traits.description: A powerful gale surrounds the DGR, bending and twisting at its whim. When a creature ends their turn within 60 feet of the DGR while it is not incapacitated, the DGR may choose to have them make a DC 16 Strength saving throw. On a failure, they are either moved 30 feet in any direction the DGR chooses or are knocked prone. If the creature is flying in an environment with planetary gravity, it has disadvantage on this saving throw.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The DGR makes two Eidotalon attacks.

actions.name: Eidotalon
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 17 (2d10 + 6) piercing damage plus 7 (1d12) lightning damage.

actions.name: Storm Center (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The DGR unleashes a wave of lightning that bounces between all targets it chooses within 60 feet of it, who each must make a DC 16 Dexterity saving throw, taking 55 (10d10) lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

actions.name: Mach Boost
actions.description: The DGR doubles its movement speed until the end of its turn and takes the Dash action.

reactions.name: Wind Control
reactions.description: When a creature starts its turn within range of the DGR’s Galeforce Generator or enters that space for the first time on their turn, the DGR may use its reaction to immediately treat the creature as though it had ended its turn there, and force them to save against that trait. They do not do so again at the end of their turn when this happens.
